_note_on_consumer_choice: The cash discount program is branded Consumer Choice — that is the name used in the Restaurant mega-menu offer, so the whole site now matches. `program_name` is the brand name, `short` is the plain-English version for tight spaces. Compliance note: cash discount / dual pricing carries card-brand and state disclosure requirements, so have someone check the wording of any '0%' or 'keep 100% of your fees' claim before launch.
